questions.q: In the illustrative data, which lead source converts best, and which supplies the most leads?
options: Web converts best; Purchased List supplies the most
Partner Referral converts best; Web supplies the most leads
Purchased List converts best; Partner Referral supplies the most
Phone Inquiry converts best and supplies the most
questions.explain: Partner Referral converts at 25% while Web supplies the most leads (480 of 1,000).

questions.q: How is coverage calculated for Alder & Vale this quarter?
options: $1.71M won divided by $2.25M quota
$4.8M total open pipeline divided by 96 deals
$1.35M open pipeline closing this quarter divided by the $540K remaining gap
140 won deals divided by 400 closed deals
questions.explain: Coverage compares open pipeline that could close this quarter to the remaining gap: 1.35M / 540K = 2.5x.

questions.q: Why can 2.5x coverage still fall short at a 35% win rate?
options: Because 35% of $1.35M is about $473K, which is less than the $540K gap
Because coverage ratios are illegal to calculate
Because win rate only applies to lost deals
Because coverage always equals win rate
questions.explain: Expected closed revenue is roughly pipeline times win rate; $473K is below the $540K needed.

questions.q: Which SOQL clause pair produces open pipeline totals by stage?
options: WHERE IsClosed = true ... ORDER BY Name
WHERE IsWon = true ... GROUP BY LeadSource
WHERE Amount = null ... LIMIT 1
WHERE IsClosed = false ... GROUP BY StageName
questions.explain: Open pipeline is IsClosed = false, and grouping by StageName gives counts and sums per stage.

questions.q: Which filter finds stalled deals in this project?
options: Closed = False and Last Activity older than 30 days or blank
Closed = True and Stage = Closed Won
Lead Source = Purchased List
Created Date = LAST 90 DAYS on Leads
questions.explain: Stalled deals are open opportunities with no recent activity, including those with no activity at all.
